name: Extinguishing the Idol
summary: Belnistrasz asks you to reach the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs. He intends to perform a ritual to shut it down.

sections.title: The Idol
sections.body: In Razorfen Downs, Belnistrasz needs you beside him at the Quilboar's idol. You are to escort him there and protect him while he performs a ritual to shut it down. The idol's continued presence is what the ritual seeks to end.

faq.answer: Belnistrasz is the one you escort to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs.

faq.q: What does Belnistrasz want to do?
faq.answer: Belnistrasz plans to perform a ritual to shut down the Quilboar's idol.
The Quilboar's idol is in Razorfen Downs.

faq.q: Why do I need to go with Belnistrasz?
aliases: what am I supposed to do
faq.answer: You are asked to escort Belnistrasz to the idol and protect him during his ritual.

attribution: In-game quest text: Extinguishing the Idol
